mapper.select: SELECT p.pile_id AS pileId, p.pile_code AS pileCode, p.pile_type AS pileType, p.power_kw AS powerKw, p.connector_type AS connectorType, p.pile_status AS pileStatus, CASE WHEN p.pile_status = '0' THEN '空闲' WHEN p.pile_status = '1' THEN '充电中' WHEN p.pile_status = '2' THEN '离线' WHEN p.pile_status = '3' THEN '故障' ELSE p.pile_status END AS statusText, p.voltage, p.current_a AS `current`, p.power_now AS powerNow, p.last_heartbeat AS lastHeartbeat, p.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM stad_charging_pile p WHERE p.station_id = #{stationId} ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.pile_code

SELECT p.pile_id AS pileId, p.pile_code AS pileCode, p.pile_type AS pileType, p.power_kw AS powerKw, p.connector_type AS connectorType, p.pile_status AS pileStatus, p.voltage, p.current_a AS `current`, p.power_now AS powerNow, p.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM stad_charging_pile p WHERE p.station_id = #{stationId} AND p.pile_code = #{pileNo} LIMIT 1
